components.name: Labelled call waterfall
components.description: One readable row per call, with captured interval and available tool duration kept separate; selection opens the same call in the inspector.
components.html: Tool / argumentsCaptured timeTool time
components.css: .ds-waterfall{font-family:var(--font-sans,"Archivo Variable",sans-serif);width:100%;min-width:300px;color:var(--color-ink,#202d45);background:var(--color-sheet,#fff)}.ds-head,.ds-call{display:grid;grid-template-columns:166px minmax(0,1fr) 68px;align-items:center}.ds-head{min-height:36px;background:var(--color-paper,#f3f6fb);font-size:10px;color:var(--color-ink-2,#58677f)}.ds-head>span{padding:8px 12px}.ds-call{width:100%;min-height:56px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule,#e3e8f1);background:var(--color-sheet,#fff);color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-call:hover{background:var(--color-paper,#f3f6fb)}.ds-call[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--color-yellow-soft,#edf0ff)}.ds-label{min-width:0;padding:8px 12px}.ds-label strong{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.ds-label small{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:4px;color:var(--color-ink-2,#58677f);font:10px/1.5 var(--font-mono,monospace)}.ds-track{position:relative;align-self:stretch;min-width:0;margin:0 6px;border-inline:1px solid var(--color-rule,#e3e8f1)}.ds-bar{position:absolute;top:18px;left:20%;width:25%;height:18px;border:1px solid var(--series-1,#258c83);border-radius:3px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--series-1,#258c83) 30%,var(--color-sheet,#fff))}.ds-call[aria-pressed=true] .ds-bar{outline:1px solid var(--color-accent,#4f5fc7);outline-offset:2px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--series-1,#258c83) 45%,var(--color-sheet,#fff))}.ds-duration{padding:8px 12px 8px 6px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;font-size:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--color-ink-2,#58677f)}.ds-unknown{position:absolute;top:20px;left:6px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:10px;color:var(--color-ink-3,#65758d)}.ds-call:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#4f5fc7);outline-offset:-2px}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-head,.ds-call{grid-template-columns:132px minmax(0,1fr) 58px}}

components.name: Captured payload
components.description: Cool label strip, framed code and safe syntax colours.
components.css: .ds-payload{font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif);width:340px;border:1px solid var(--color-rule,#e3e8f1);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--color-sheet,#fff);color:var(--color-ink,#202d45)}.ds-payload-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--color-paper,#f3f6fb);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule,#e3e8f1);font-size:11px;line-height:16.5px}.ds-payload-label strong{font-weight:600}.ds-payload-label span{font-weight:400;color:var(--color-ink-2,#58677f)}.ds-payload-label strong span{margin-left:8px;color:var(--color-ink-3,#65758d)}.ds-payload pre{margin:0;padding:12px 14px;font:11px/1.9 var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);tab-size:2;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap}.ds-key{color:var(--code-key,#4f5fc7)}.ds-string{color:var(--code-string,#19776b)}

narrative.overview:
Trace Atlas treats a recording as navigable evidence. A navy navigation rail anchors a cool, layered workspace; compact measurements and aligned rows make dense captured data readable. Archivo carries the interface, with monospace reserved chiefly for captured arguments, identifiers and JSON.

Analytical cartography supplies the signature: one labelled waterfall row combines each call’s identity and captured interval, registered with the inspector. Tool series remain consistent across these regions. Borders and tonal changes give each region a clear job while the inspector preserves room for the evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, white panels and a stable graphite navigation rail with fine borders.
Periwinkle selection shared across waterfall intervals, rows and filters.
Tool series identify categories; amber and explicit status marks identify reported errors.
Compact tabular measurements, readable captured payloads and restrained rounded geometry.

rules.name: The Registered Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected call uses the same identity in the labelled waterfall row and inspector; periwinkle communicates selection rather than tool category.

rules.name: The Separate Measures Rule
rules.body: Captured request-to-response intervals and source-reported tool duration are distinct measurements. Keep their labels and visual positions distinct; unavailable values remain unavailable.

rules.name: The Bordered Surface Rule
rules.body: Use cool tonal steps and hairline borders for panel hierarchy. Reserve rings for selection and focus, rather than adding floating panel shadows.

dos: Do keep each tool’s series colour consistent across the waterfall and profile.
Do pair status colour with a readable label or SVG status icon.
Do align times, counts and sizes with tabular figures.
Do keep the selected call and its captured payload readable at laptop and mobile sizes.
Do retain visible focus and remove transitions under reduced motion.
Do label retained JSON size and reported duration precisely.
donts: Don't use tool-series colour as the only indication of an error or selection.
Don't describe captured intervals as model thinking time, or retained JSON as original output or context usage.
Don't replace unavailable measurements with a measured zero.
Don't add decorative metric tiles, imagery or panel shadows to this evidence-led cockpit.
Don't turn historical policy metadata into live approval controls.
